boundary_convention: minima inclusive; maxima follow each region's max_inclusive setting

india.name: India (Natural Earth country boundary)

country_boundary.source: Natural Earth Admin-0 Countries, India POV

tiling.edge_rule: west/south inclusive; east/north exclusive except the outermost region edge, which is inclusive

india.notes: The rectangular bbox is only the fixed tile-grid extent; FIRMS membership is additionally constrained by the Natural Earth 10m India POV polygon. Nationwide distances remain partitioned into local tiles.

jharkhand.name: Jharkhand state (OSM administrative boundary)

country_boundary.source_version: Geofabrik Eastern Zone extract 261016; OSM data through 2026-10-16
country_boundary.source_license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; attribute OpenStreetMap contributors

tiling.edge_rule: west/south inclusive; east/north exclusive except the outermost region edge, which is inclusive

boundary_limitations: OSM administrative boundary from the pinned 2026-10-16 extract; not a legal survey boundary.
Administrative geometry may differ from authoritative government demarcations.
jharkhand.notes: The OSM state polygon constrains the bounding-box tile grid. FIRMS rows outside the state polygon are excluded; matching uses one local UTM CRS per tile and recurrence uses a tile-independent equal-area grid.
